verdict.rationale: Featurebase says it connects to 'your favorite tools in just a few clicks' and centralizes feedback through integrations. It also pulls in Slack, Discord and email conversations, which covers chat tools. Webhooks and a posts/feedback API allow custom wiring to other systems, but no named support or sales integrations appear, so those likely need custom work. Missing for 10: named support-tool integrations (e.g. helpdesk) that push feedback, named sales/CRM integrations, documentation of how feedback is captured from those tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
